It had a decent amount of health, with defense and either above average or below average speed depending the mode. Additionally, it had an ability where it will attack a tower in its range, stunning it for a few seconds. ==Appearance== The '''Knight''' wore white and grey fully body armor, with a purple cape. It wielded a wooden sword and held a wooden shield with poorly plastered orange and purple panels. While running, it held up its shield in front of it with its left arm. It has grey eyes. ==Strategy== *Multiple cheaper towers, like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Golden Soldier]], [[Militant]] or [[Crook Boss]] can kill this quite easily. *Towers with the capability to damage chains of enemies at once, like the [[Executioner]] or the [[Pyromancer]], are extremely useful against this enemy. **The [[Pyromancer]] and [[Golden Pyromancer]] can also be useful at decreasing its defense. *Placing down cheap towers as a distraction near the entrance, such as a Level 0 [[Scout]] or [[Golden Scout]], can be very helpful by distracting the '''Knight''', making it stop moving and giving you more time to kill it. **You can also try to place important towers away from the path to avoid them getting stunned. ***This is not as viable in the [[The Great Finale|third act]] however, as almost all of the placeable areas are close to the path, inevitably allowing some towers to be stunned and there are usually plenty of other enemies distracting towers from attacking the '''Knights'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} KnightRun.Gif|Running animation (28 October 2023 – 21 December 2023) KnightAttack.gif|''Sword Slash'' animation (28 October 2023 – 21 December 2023) {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Act 1 Scene 1|'''Knight''' in the opening [[A Dark Tale]] cutscene. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Knight''' shares similarities with the [[Knight (Solar Eclipse)|Knight]] from [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. *The internal name of the '''Knight''' is ''Knight Plush''. *The '''Knight''' had a rather slow attack animation, which often caused it to die while in the process of stunning a tower. **This did not stun the tower. ==Update History== *'''28 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]b **'''Knight''' added. *'''12 November 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]l **Now appears in [[The Great Finale]]. *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Knight''' removed. {{ADarkTale|[[Citizen Plush (Lunar Overture)|Citizen Plush]]|Wave 10|Knight|Wave 12|[[Cobalt Guard (Lunar Overture)|Cobalt Guard]]|Wave 13}} {{TheGreatFinale|[[Citizen Plush (Lunar Overture)|Citizen Plush]]|Wave 2|Knight|Wave 3|[[Actor2 (Lunar Overture)|Actor2]]|Wave 5}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Knight}}
